message: The maintainer makes measured focus repair NUIAK's highest priority. Support a complete failure-to-generation-to-training-to-evaluation cycle. Preserve active jobs and reuse completed evidence.
ready_work: Use the existing EVIDENCE223 and BD18/22/25/27 assignments to report supported failure categories, missing label evidence and regression metrics. Reuse current results; do not repeat unchanged model scoring.
Return the current queue, available resident training tools and exact missing inputs for one controlled baseline-versus-candidate comparison. Use existing reports where possible.
next_training_contract: NUIAK will supply exact synthetic inputs, hashes, data roles, initialization, preprocessing, epochs or updates, storage budget and acceptance criteria. Wait for that package before starting a new fit. Return checkpoints, per-case predictions, timing, configuration and failure records with hashes.
budget: Ready evidence work retains the existing EVIDENCE223 and worker-followup231 limits. This message adds no model run, dependency download or additional compute budget.
evaluation: Keep training, development and reserved evaluation groups separate. Include previous successful cases, false changes and abstentions. NUIAK independently verifies results and decides promotion.
response: Acknowledge this request. Identify completed reusable work, the next assigned action and exact missing inputs. Do not interrupt an active owned job.
